notes.title: v2.0.3
notes.notes:
Added some camera shake to jumping, braking, and dying in the game for a better game feel.

Implemented a bug detector in the game.  It will alert users if a bug occurs and will let you copy them and you can send that error message to me via steam or via email,.

notes.title: V. 2.0.2
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where the audio levels weren't initialized properly.

If you have a game breaking bug please let me know!
